title: Brand Strategy - Client Lead
description: Life & Half is a strategy-led creative agency out to build brand culture — not just brand content. We work with some of India's most recognisable consumer brands, like UNO India, District, Ferns N Petals, Hyatt hotels, Coffee Island, Vip Shaadi and others who care deeply about culture, craft, and getting it right.Eligibility: Previous Account Management + team management + strategy planning or brand management experience. Your application will be rejected without this combination of experience.3-5 yrs work experienceMandatory experience woking with a brand or an agencyYou have done or plan to do your MBA and are obsessed about growing as a marketer and have a founder mindset at workRole Objective: This is not a servicing role. It's a thinking role that happens to sit closest to the client.This role is for someone who will lead brand-planning, strategy and group of Account Managers and handle 12-16 brands - owning L&H strategy muscle while leading our brand portfolio to success.We're looking for someone who can walk into a client room and hold the conversation strategically - not just deliver updates, but shape how a brand thinks. Someone whose instinct for culture is sharp, whose presence clients trust, and who genuinely enjoys nurturing the relationship as much as the work.We're looking for someone who is equal parts strategist and relationship builder.You'll own key client accounts end to end — from planning, ops to delivery — and lead a team of five account managers doing the same. You'll be the person clients trust to think for them, not just execute for them.Apply only if:You love the daily hustle of fast-paced work environment and are comfortable in high-pressure situations. Our clients are building some of the coolest well-known brands of India and that comes with phenomenal expectations. Our clients are well known industry leaders (Founders, VCs, CMOs and CEOs) & professionals and you should be comfortable, well-researched in interacting with them.What you'll actually doStrategy & brand capitalOwn the strategy and narrative for key accounts. Build annual and quarterly brand plans to keep the brands sharply on-culture. For this you will have to be equally obsessed with internet, social media and creator culture.Lead brand strategy on key accounts — bring sharp cultural and consumer thinking into every piece of workBuild sharp briefs that build strong insights for creative direction.You think in brand, not just deliverables. You will often be presenting to senior management and you are comfortable holding ground - with directions rooted in sharp strategy - with room to pivot fast.You will be responsible for complete projects management, SOP setup, daily workflow management - ensuring timely and error-free deliveries.Along with managing client experience you will also be responsible for the brand's performance through research insights driven intel, developing marketing strategies, analytics, managing content creation and creative team work flow.Periodic review of brand's performance and sourcing consumer insightsDrive extensive research - consumer studies, primary surveys, online research, competition scan to drive intel on brands to clients and creative team.Be up to date on latest developments in social media platforms, retail media and content marketing.Have strong analytical skills, deeply understand social media analytics and have decent knowledge of using microsoft excelExcellent client nurturingThere are historic agency-client partnership lore which have led to iconic brand narratives - you will be building the same culture capital for your clients.Own client relationships end-to-end — from brief to delivery to the conversations that happen in betweenBe the primary point of contact for marquee clients; they should never feel the need to escalateLead and mentor a team of account managers — set the standard, build the culture, raise the barCollaborate closely with the founder on account health, creative direction, and strategic pivotsRepresent L&H in client meetings with the confidence and clarity of someone who owns the roomRun client relationships independently — you won't need to loop in the founder for every call. Team nurturing and internal intel:You will build strong ops and SOPs for different projects - from social media to branding to strategy.Lead your team of 4-6 Account Managers into timely work delivery, while also shaping their knack for culture.Build SOPs for centralising company intel - from topical calendars, creator outreach to client happinessWho you areAbout 3 years in — agency, brand strategy, or planning background preferredStrategically sharp: you can read a brand brief and see what others missNaturally warm and excellent in conversation — clients feel held, not managedCulturally fluent: you understand what's moving on the internet right now and why it matters to brandsComfortable leading people, natural leadership qualityYou write and speak with clarity — no jargon, no fluffWhat you getDirect access to the founder and their way of thinking — this is accelerated learning, not a slow career ladderFront-row seat on some of India's most visible brand mandates and direct interaction with some of India's best CMOs, Founders, marketers and Brand Heads on client sideA small, high-trust team where your instincts actually shape the workIndustry networks that most people spend a decade buildingCompensation that grows with you — ₹9-16 LPA to start, with room to move fast Show more Show less Life & Half is a strategy-led creative agency out to build brand culture — not just brand content.
